design_freeze: Harness is stdlib only, one nonforking Python process; no subprocess, network, threads, date helper or model calls. Nothing runs at import; all work inside run().

Every module (reader, capture4, schema2, adapter3) and the frozen plan JSON are pinned by full SHA256. The reader is bootstrapped by a harness-local descriptor-anchored NOFOLLOW one-link cap+1 read and verified before compile/exec in a fresh non-main namespace; everything else is read through a real EvidenceReader instance and verified before use.

REAL_FILESYSTEM cases use an unmodified reader namespace (real os). LABELLED_BOUNDARY_FAULT cases load a separate reader namespace from the same verified bytes whose os name is a labelled delegating proxy: every native call really happens (or the label says it was suppressed), faults are injected only before/after it, natively acquired handles not returned to the reader are retained and closed exactly once after an identity check; no close by guessed number, no double close.
Fault timing uses event-armed deadline callbacks (never /bin/date, never a model clock presented as real time); an armed original deadline is never renewed.

Fixtures are created only under the evidence root with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW through retained directory descriptors; mutations during a case are creation-only (new hard link, new directory entry) or labelled appends to a harness-created growth fixture; no unlink, rename, truncate, overwrite or chmod/utime of any file; FIFOs/links/fixtures are kept.

No fixture or negative ever writes the MOLS39 plan audit dir, runs-ext-search-v4, n1-fault-v1 or any pre-existing path. Synthetic fixtures carry explicit SYNTHETIC labels in their bytes; synthetic exits are predicate inputs, never measured exits; synthetic date records are labelled and never presented as /bin/date.

Composed adapter cases can now only reach AUDITED_FAIL: with no genuine 17-record B-BAD_PIN prefix or genuine DATA outputs, audit_schema returns X5 whenever reached. Expected cause lists include that X5 explicitly; every PASS-dependent obligation is DEFERRED with exact prerequisites.

Exactly one JSON stdout line per plan case (deferred cases included, marked not executed) plus one summary line; stdout <=1 MiB; stderr empty on success; self-budget 300 s checked after every case against the original monotonic deadline; retained evidence bytes <=20 MiB; exit 0 only when every executable case matches its frozen expectation, distinct nonzero codes otherwise; a non-injected BaseException from a module is recorded on stdout then re-raised.
Expected outcomes are frozen in the plan JSON before any execution; the harness pins the plan SHA256 and refuses on any plan/harness case-set mismatch.
